record.field: Alerts when the cloud filestore bucket stops working or works again.

This channel gets the alerts of the cloud filestore.

You get one message when the file bucket stops working and one when it works again. During an outage, new files stay in the local filestore and nobody loses work. The catch-up job uploads them later.

You also get a message when the module is not loaded as a server-wide module.

To send the alerts to another channel, set the system parameter oteny_cloud_filestore.alert_channel_id.
